_note: Generic Mesoamerican base (BASE_10): the pyramid-cities, the glyph-scribes, the sun-and-jade temple. Single-language Maya-Aztec register sourced from culture_tlanec.json (the Maya-Nahua fusion kit, kept separately). Here treated as ONE generic Mesoamerican base tongue - so NO blend and NO fusion_rules; tlanec's lexicon, titles and religion serve as the base's single register. civ = feudal. Seeds/shifts across all three alignments. Common-word lexicon and rank titles use the real Maya-Nahuatl register (allowed, catalog 5.3); ruler/domain DISPLAY titles are ENGLISH, with the Mesoamerican forms in ruler_native/domain_native for NPC dialogue. DEITY names are canon-morphs (the shared Agrippan pantheon via the family's Nahuatl/Maya morph-sets), never real Meso gods. The Plumed-Serpent is the dynastic kingship-symbol and Toltec legitimacy, NOT a god.

phonology.palette: Nahuatl backbone (absolutive -tl/-tli/-tzin; tl/tz/ch/x; place -tlan/-tepec) with a Mayan overlay (glottalized touches, x = sh shared, the aj-/ix- agentives in the substrate); theophoric on the Nahua names with Maya variants.
phonology.phonotactics: CV(C); the -tl cluster; Maya glottal stops in substrate names.

morphology.patronymic_form: the calpolli (ward) or ch'ib'al (Maya lineage); calendar-day names; a deed/war-name; nobles trace the tecuhtli line or a Maya ajaw dynasty.
morphology.compounding_rule: [quality|feature](stem) + place-suffix: Huei-tepec (great-mountain), Cuauh-tlan (eagle-place); Maya overlay Chak-witz (red-pyramid).

title_ladder.government: feudal (the Nahuatl tlatoani ladder over a Maya substrate; the Plumed-Serpent throne legitimizes the dynasty)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Generic Mesoamerican ladder, ascending. Display titles ENGLISH; native forms are the Nahuatl tlatoani ladder over a Maya substrate. Tecuhtli (lord) barony; Nakom (Maya war-captain) march; Ajaw (Maya lord) county; Tlatoani (city-king) duchy; K'uhul Tlatoani (holy-speaker - Maya k'uhul + Nahua tlatoani, the divine king) principality; Hueyi Tlatoani (great speaker) kingdom; Cem-Anahuac Tlatoani (ruler of all) empire. The Plumed-Serpent throne (the Toltec legacy) legitimizes the line. (Native rank titles are the real Nahuatl/Maya register, allowed.)
title_ladder.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH. The *_native conlang forms are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.

people_name_convention.order: calendar-day name + deed/war-name + calpolli or ch'ib'al; the Nahua court favors -tzin titles, the Maya substrate the aj-/ix- prefixes.
people_name_convention.dual_register: the Nahua-speaking court uses -tzin lordly names; the Maya substrate keeps aj-/ix- names.
people_name_convention.theophoric: names invoke the powers (Nahua names, Maya variants) + an element: -tzin (revered), Teo- (divine), or Maya aj-/ix-: e.g. Tolra-tzin, Aj-Tulax.

religion._note: Tollanaz uses the Nahuatl divine-names primarily, with the Maya names as the older substrate register (court-Nahua / folk-Maya) - the same shared Agrippan pantheon under two name-sets, never real Meso gods. The Plumed-Serpent (the feathered serpent) is the dynastic KINGSHIP-symbol and Toltec legitimacy, NOT a god. Tollanaz seeds/shifts Lawful, Neutral, or Chaotic; its stance follows its CURRENT alignment (see worship_by_alignment).
religion.the_one: Aiternatl (< Aeternus; Maya substrate: Aj Ternaj) - the One; revered as supreme Giver-of-Life when Lawful, set aside when Neutral, reviled as the tyrant-sun when Chaotic

sample_deity_renames.Tulrius: Tolratl / Maya Tulax (sun and law; Lawful power)
sample_deity_renames.Realta: Rialtzin / Maya Ix Rialtaj (the mother; Neutral-honored)
sample_deity_renames.Maraxus: Marakatl / Maya Marakab (the war-fire; Chaotic power)

worship_by_alignment.Lawful: revere the One (Aiternatl) and the Lawful powers (Tolratl, Orlantzin, Numenatl, Gaiantli), demonize the Chaotic
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: all powers ambivalent - somewhat honored, somewhat feared; foreground the achtontli (ancestral dead), the day-lords and local spirits
worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: venerate the Chaotic powers (Marakatl, Wakitl, Lusankoatl), demonize the Lawful powers and the One

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the demonized set (by current alignment) take dread epithets: when Lawful - Maraxus -> Marakatl the Flayer; when Chaotic - Tulrius -> Tolratl the Cold-Sun, Aeternus -> Aiternatl the Tyrant-Sun.
religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Teocalli (Nahua) or K'uh-nah (Maya) atop the pyramid of [power]: 'the Teocalli of Tolratl', 'the K'uh-nah of Tulax'.
religion.saints_pattern: the Plumed-Serpent dynasts, deified rulers and fallen warriors, honored at the teocalli and the ancestral tomb.

holy_symbol_motifs.the Plumed Serpent: a feathered serpent coiled about the throne (the Toltec kingship-sign, not a god)
holy_symbol_motifs.Marakatl: an obsidian knife over a blood-eagle

banks_patterns.ships: trade-canoes and the great seagoing canoe: 'the Jade Canoe', 'the Plumed Serpent', 'the Quetzal of Tollan'
banks_patterns.military_units: the warrior-societies: the [order] knights: 'the Eagle Knights (Cuauhtli)', 'the Jaguar Knights (Ocelotl)', 'the Serpent Guard'
banks_patterns.taverns: the octli (pulque) and cacao house: 'the [Adjective] [Noun]': 'the Cacao House', 'the Flower-Song Court'
banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: abandoned teocalli, vine-choked pyramids and the ruins of old Tollans: 'the lost Teocalli of [name]', 'the Sunken Tlan of [tlatoani]'
